categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and changes anchor connection management in src/net to preserve block-relay-only peers across restarts.
categories.rationale: Prevents overwriting anchors.dat with an empty list on clean shutdown when networking is disabled, avoiding degradation of eclipse attack resilience on subsequent restarts. As noted in the discussion, 'preserving them across a clean shutdown lets the node reconnect when networking resumes, increasing eclipse attack resilience'.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Triggered by network deactivation via setnetworkactive, but changes underlying peer connection persistence rather than the RPC interface or handling.
categories.rationale: Does not change RPC interfaces, parameters, or return formats; the change is purely internal to P2P connection management.
